newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's cuts Japan life insurers' ratings outlooks.
newsitem.headline: Moody's cuts Japan life insurers' ratings outlooks.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday that it had changed its ratings outlooks for Meiji Mutual Life Insurance Co and Dai-Ichi Mutual Life Insurance Co to negative from stable.
"Meiji and Dai-Ichi, along with the rest of the life insurers, have been experiencing significant earnings and capital pressures from product offerings," said Moody's.
The private rating firm said it expects deregulation to increase competitive pressures on Japan's insurance industry.
Moody's also said recent volatility in the Japanese stock market underscored the vulnerability of the insurers' domestic stock portfolio.
